profile.headline: Senior Backend Engineer | Kotlin · Microservices · Domain-Driven Design | Building Scalable, Reliable Systems at Enterprise Scale
profile.summary: As a dedicated Senior Software Engineer, I bring a combination of technical expertise and strategic thinking. With a background in designing and developing scalable solutions, I specialize in Kotlin and have hands-on experience with distributed architectures. I thrive in environments that require both precision and adaptability, driving projects from ideation to implementation while collaborating across cross-functional teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led the architecture and rollout of multiple large-scale, high-traffic platforms, delivering measurable business impact including improved user engagement and zero major production incidents post launch.

Modernized a legacy system into a high-throughput distributed microservice capable of 6k+ TPS by leveraging event-driven architecture, RocksDB, and Kafka, reducing latency to under 100ms and dramatically improving data accuracy.

Directed cross-functional technical strategy across engineering, product, and third-party partners to deliver scalable services, consolidate duplicated logic, and streamline data pipelines for higher reliability and easier maintenance.

Served as Team Lead and primary technical point of contact, mentoring engineers, facilitating refinements, producing clear architectural documentation and diagrams, and delivering technical presentations to leadership, early-career engineers, and external audiences.

positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
Led the end-to-end design and delivery of new backend services and APIs, establishing clear technical direction, improving data reliability, and enabling cross-team development with well-defined specifications.

Implemented high-impact platform improvements, including caching layers, CI/CD templates, performance monitoring, and load-testing setups, which  reduced system strain, standardized pipelines, and improved overall operational readiness.

Demonstrated strong incident ownership by resolving complex production issues, improving documentation, and creating support playbooks that accelerated troubleshooting and strengthened team preparedness.

positions.title: Product Owner
positions.description:
Target Technology Leadership Program Trainee - Rotation 3

• Created functional user stories that articulate business needs 

• Learned/worked the key mechanics of a Scrum framework 

• Took the initiative towards creating UI standards on mobile teams 

• Created over 20 mobile mockup screens, several of which were developed and went into production

• In 4 months learned the basic functional and technical aspects of the myWork technology used in over 1,800 Target stores

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Target Technology Leadership Program Trainee - Rotation 2 

• Facilitated cross-functional team work sessions, daily stand-ups, and weekly touch bases with partner teams

• Acted as a liaison between project team and leadership through weekly communications

• Organized the effort to update data feeds to increase and/or maintain results reporting

positions.title: Process Analyst/Project Manager
positions.description:
Target Technology Leadership Program Trainee - Rotation 1 

• Created a community to provide a solid platform for two-way communication between partners and the Configuration Manager infrastructure team.

• Created a central repository and platform for SCCM infrastructure team to communicate internally and store vital information.

positions.title: Volunteer
positions.description: Organized files important to the organization. Prioritized all donated books along with other items to be sold in the organization's annual book fair. Priced all items against competitors for the customers best value at the book fair as well.

positions.title: Consultant Supervisor
positions.description: Provided direct assistance to customers in the student computing labs in regards to software, hardware, and computer peripheral equipment. Maintained the lab environments that support the academic mission of IU students. Provided direct assistance to campus housing residents in acquiring and maintaining their network connection to IU's computer network.

positions.title: Technology Consultant
positions.description: Provided technical help to students, faculty, and staff of Indiana University. Answered questions about software, hardware, and even campus questions to all students, faculty, and staff.

company.name: Indiana University School of Informatics and Computing

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Provided networking and technical help to non-profit companies in the Bloomington community. Sought out the level of need and assist the company in better management of their technical equipment and help with upgrading if necessary.

company.name: Indiana University's Serve IT Non-Profit Company

positions.title: Technology Service Intern
positions.description: Developed Application Dashboard for Merchandising Apps that do not have Real User Monitoring (RUM). Determine processes to engage support engineers for merchandising and transportation to make this a part of their regular support activities.

honors.title: Dean's List
honors.description: This honor is given to students who have completed a semester with a 3.5 G.P.A or higher. I was a third time honoree.
honors.issuer: Issued by School of Informatics and Computing · Jan 2014
